__doc: Canonical role vocabulary for the SGS cloning pipeline. THE source of truth for the `roles` table — db_lookup._migrate_roles_table() seeds from this file on module load (INSERT OR REPLACE + DELETE-NOT-IN two-way sync).
__why: Was a hardcoded Python dict of 21 entries while the live DB held 29. The 8 extra were each added by a one-off migration that wrote the DB row and never back-wrote the seed, so a rebuild silently lost them. That is the decay class Phase 0/1 exists to end, and a hardcoded routing dict also breaches R-31-1. Captured from live 2026-08-02.
icon-dashicon: Icon-source value: a Dashicons name (e.g. sgs/icon.dashiconName).
icon-emoji: Icon-source value: a bare emoji glyph (e.g. sgs/icon.emojiChar).
icon-lucide: Icon-source value: a Lucide slug (e.g. sgs/icon.iconName). Content-bearing display value the cloning icon arm lifts by role, not a styling property.
image-alt: Alt text for a sibling image-object attr (e.g. sgs/product-card.imageAlt, sgs/media.imageAlt). Content-bearing display value the cloning image arm lifts alongside the image URL, not a styling property. The specific image attr it belongs to is named by block_attributes.alt_companion_attr (db_lookup.image_alt_companion_for), never guessed by name-parsing.
position: Stacking-context / positioning value (e.g. sgs/decorative-image.zIndex) - a layout-positioning property, not content. Added 2026-07-15 (F6: enrichment derived the role before its roles row existed; the D128 scalar-media class of gap).
rating: Star/numeric rating value (e.g. sgs/testimonial.ratingStars) — a content-bearing display value, not a styling property.
tag-identity: The attr stores the source element's HTML tag (sgs/heading.level, sgs/media.mediaType). R-31-2 shape fact written by assembly step 3a2, gated on enum membership. Structural identity, never content-walked.
